rows.description: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, personal knowledge management (PKM), and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

Synthadoc: An open-source LLM knowledge compilation engine that turns raw documents into structured, local-first wikis. A transparent, human-readable alternative to traditional RAG, which can be self-managed and self-improved without the use of any tools.

Persistent memory for Claude Code, Codex and 6 other AI agents, stored as plain markdown in your Obsidian vault. New: Crew, one shared logbook so Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok Bot know what each other did. 48 commands: semantic search, self-rewriting notes, key-less research, scheduled agents.

An open-source personal learning agent with three-layer memory (learner profile / wiki knowledge base / cross-conversation recall), a proactive scheduler, personal IM channels, and a workspace-scoped Practice Lab — built on the Pi SDK.
The malleable knowledge base for you and your team. Powered by Markdown and Lua.

把中文全渠道内容（抖音 / B站 / 小红书 / 公众号 / X / 播客）采集进个人知识库的 14 个 AI Skill：图文存图、视频转文字稿、字幕优先免 GPU、RSS/YouTube 订阅调度与每日情报简报，附带知识库 MCP server。｜ Ingest Chinese content into your personal knowledge base — image/video routing, subtitle-first transcription, feed subscriptions with daily digests, and a KB MCP server.
Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
Open Brain — The infrastructure layer for your thinking. One database, one AI gateway, one chat channel — any AI plugs in. No middleware, no SaaS.

A personal knowledge base that builds and maintains itself. Drop in sources — Claude (or Codex/Gemini) reads them, extracts knowledge, and maintains a persistent interlinked wiki. Works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI. No API key needed.
